purpose: Independently judge the candidate against the original request, scoped check and affected contracts; report blockers without repairing.

execution.instructions: Read the full scoped Go execution receipt; missing selected tests, incomplete execution and skipped proof are not acceptance. Read the accepted plan/card manifest and verify every card acceptance condition against the original request, current combined patch and supplied full evidence. Internal card pins are unreviewed. Require complete structured request/seed/phase/work evidence for the investigation; report evidence_status alone is not proof of completeness. Missing sidecars or truncated stdout cannot prove the original failure resolved. Read the required before_measurements artifact retained from the first candidate measurement before correction, the latest measurements artifact, and the pristine baseline_measurements artifact. Independently compare complete pre-correction and post-correction request/seed/phase/work records for every authorized case. Preserve negative samples and distinguish changed seeds or environments from matched comparisons. The pristine baseline establishes only its original selected controls; absent case coverage and lost historical seeds cannot establish matched replay or prove the original timeout fixed. A failed baseline is failure evidence, never a successful timing claim. Require a supported cause and meaningful unchanged acceptance conditions. Independently review the original scoped Go request, retained patch, actual focused check and measurement evidence. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md; read only affected source/contracts needed to judge completeness, correctness, public behavior, generated ownership, unnecessary work and meaningful test purpose/placement. Source is read-only. Do not edit, retest, use Git, launch agents or perform external work. Downstream packaging, runtime/browser qualification and protected release still must pass. Return ready with verdict exactly APPROVE only for a complete source handoff with sufficient supplied focused proof. A concrete in-scope repair returns changes_requested with verdict BLOCKED. Missing capability, infrastructure uncertainty or a required material decision returns blocked. Do not waive proof or widen scope. Keep findings and any missing proof in a summary of at most 240 characters. Canonical runner-measure-history-v1 is final current measurement evidence. Parse every ordered entry, including latest/intermediate reports and bindings; choose matched before/current by source, instrumentation, protocol, runtime and seeds, never round alone. Source narrative must be truthful as-of its supplied reports and cite canonical history; do not demand its own future measurement/hash. Never omit canonical entries or waive unsupported claims. The immutable before_measurements report and pristine baseline remain distinct; neither replaces matched instrumented evidence. The initial review may use retained checks of unchanged source; this is not fresh execution or qualification. Only for a bundle from the fixed configured runner-measure-history --source {workspace} step, verify source_bindings for the last entry: measurement_sha256 equals entry.sha256 and SHA256(exact measurement JSON bytes); source equals entry.source in identity, sha256, digestMethod, files and bytes. Its fresh workspace snapshot and drift check prove current-source identity without model rehash/retest, not fresh checks, matched seeds, timeout resolution or acceptance. Only a fixed configured current check may use prepared_input: require input_verified=true, bind source_base/input_patch_id and input_patch_sha256/input_patch_bytes to the prepared patch, and verify runtime.go_version/goos/goarch. Compare supplied patch bytes/hash when available. This is not a whole-source digest, measurement identity or approval. Retained FromInput checks remain old context requiring verified producer/source provenance, never fresh by label. All domain obligations and downstream gates still apply. No massive raw prompt dumps or timing/fix claims from incomparable reports.
